title: Three-component reactions of phosphorus ylides, thiophenols, and acetyl chloride for the synthesis of (β-thioacrylates)
authors: Liu, Yunyun; Huang, Bin
citation: Phosphorus, Sulfur and Silicon and the Related Elements (2016), 191(6), 926-929
reference: Three-component reactions of phosphorus ylides, thiophenols, and acetyl chloride for the synthesis of (β-thioacrylates) | Liu, Yunyun; Huang, Bin | Phosphorus, Sulfur and Silicon and the Related Elements (2016), 191(6), 926-929
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure for the synthesis of β-sulfenylated acrylates 4. A 25-mL round-bottom flask was charged with thiophenol 1 (0.5 mmol), acetyl chloride 2a (0.5 mmol), Wittig reagent 3 (0.5 mmol), Cs2CO3 (1.0 mmol), Et3N (0.5 mmol), CH2Cl2 (2 mL), and DMF (2 mL).The vessel was stirred at 100°C(reflux) in air atmosphere (1 at air balloon) for 10 h. Upon completion (TLC), the reaction mixture was allowed to cool down to room temperature and H2O (5 mL) was added. The resulting suspension was extracted with ethyl acetate (3 × 8 mL). The organic phases were combined and dried over Na2SO4. After filtration and removing the solvent at reduced pressure, the residue was subjected to silica gel column chromatography by using 100:1 (v/v) petroleum ether/ethyl acetate as an eluant to give pure product. Methyl (E)-3-[(4-fluorophenyl)thio]but-2-enoate (4r). Light yellow solid. m.p. 38-40°C. 1H NMR: δ = 7.39 (t, 2H, J = 6.0 Hz), 7.04 (t, 2H, J = 8.2 Hz), 5.11 (s, 1H), 3.53 (s, 3H), 2.33 (s, 3H); 13C NMR: δ = 165.4, 162.5 (d, J = 250.8), 159.8 (d, J = 34.0 Hz), 137.5 (d, J = 8.2 Hz), 125.1 (d, J = 11.9), 116.9 (d, J = 21.8), 110.9 (d, J = 4.4 Hz), 50.9, 19.6; HRMS (ESI): m/z [M+H]+ Calcd. for C11H12FO2S: 227.0537; Found: 227.0533.

reference: Activation of chiral (Salen)AlCl complex by phosphorane for highly enantioselective cyanosilylation of ketones and enones | Zeng, Xing-Ping; Cao, Zhong-Yan; Wang, Xin; Chen, Long; Zhou, Feng; Zhu, Feng; Wang, Cui-Hong; Zhou, Jian | Journal of the American Chemical Society (2016), 138(1), 416-425
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), α,β-unsaturated enal 10 (0.5 mmol), and phosphorane 2 (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 10 indicated by TLC analysis. After the reaction mixture was cooled to room temperature (rt), (salen)AlCl (R,R)-1 (30.3 mg, 0.05 mmol) was added. The resulting solution was cooled to -30 or -40 °C (as indicated above) and stirred for half an hour before the addition of TMSCN (1.0 mmol). After TLC analysis indicated the full conversion of the trans-6 (cis-6 was unreactive in step 2 in most cases), the mixture was directly subjected for column chromatograph, and product 7 was isolated using petroleum ether/diethyl ether (from 100:0 to 10:1) as the eluent. The reaction with 10a was conducted for 25 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7a in 70% yield as pale yellow oil. The reaction with 10r was conducted for 20 minutes for step 1 and 1 day for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7s in 91% yield as pale yellow oil. The isomeric composition of the product: 81% ee. HPLC analysis (Chiralpak AS-H+AS-H, i PrOH/hexane = 1/99, 0.8 mL/min, 230 nm; tr (major) = 17.31 min, tr (minor) = 15.36 min). [α]D 25 = -25.4 (c = 1.0, CHCl3); 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 7.37-7.31 (m, 5H), 6.10-6.01 (m, 2H), 4.61 (s, 2H), 4.30 (d, J = 1.2 Hz, 2H), 1.66 (s, 3H), 0.25 (s, 9H); 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 142.44, 137.35, 128.55, 128.18, 128.03, 119.97, 111.13, 88.63, 82.82, 71.85, 69.09, 57.80, 30.43, 1.33; IR (ATR) ν 2958.9, 1631.1, 1454.3, 1254.4, 1127.8, 996.7, 843.1, 737.9, 697.3 cm-1; HRMS (ESI): Exact mass calcd for (C18H23NO2Si+NH4 +): 331.1836; found: 331.1836.
notes: stereoselective, 81% ee, sealed tube used, Wittig reaction (stage 1)

title: Activation of chiral (Salen)AlCl complex by phosphorane for highly enantioselective cyanosilylation of ketones and enones
authors: Zeng, Xing-Ping; Cao, Zhong-Yan; Wang, Xin; Chen, Long; Zhou, Feng; Zhu, Feng; Wang, Cui-Hong; Zhou, Jian
citation: Journal of the American Chemical Society (2016), 138(1), 416-425
reference: Activation of chiral (Salen)AlCl complex by phosphorane for highly enantioselective cyanosilylation of ketones and enones | Zeng, Xing-Ping; Cao, Zhong-Yan; Wang, Xin; Chen, Long; Zhou, Feng; Zhu, Feng; Wang, Cui-Hong; Zhou, Jian | Journal of the American Chemical Society (2016), 138(1), 416-425
experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General procedure: To a screw-capped pressure tube were added anhydrous CH2Cl2 (1.0 mL), α,β-unsaturated enal 10 (0.5 mmol), and phosphorane 2 (175.0 mg, 0.55 mmol). Then the tube was sealed and heated to 80 °C until the full consumption of 10 indicated by TLC analysis. After the reaction mixture was cooled to room temperature (rt), (salen)AlCl (R,R)-1 (30.3 mg, 0.05 mmol) was added. The resulting solution was cooled to -30 or -40 °C (as indicated above) and stirred for half an hour before the addition of TMSCN (1.0 mmol). After TLC analysis indicated the full conversion of the trans-6 (cis-6 was unreactive in step 2 in most cases), the mixture was directly subjected for column chromatograph, and product 7 was isolated using petroleum ether/diethyl ether (from 100:0 to 10:1) as the eluent. The reaction with 10a was conducted for 25 hours for step 1 and 2 days for step 2 at -30 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7a in 70% yield as pale yellow oil. The reaction with 10l and 2c was conducted for 50 minutes for step 1 and 6 hours for step 2 at -40 °C; Column chromatography afforded 7o in 98% yield as pale yellow oil. The isomeric composition of the product: 84% ee. HPLC analysis (Chiralpak IC-H+IC-H, i PrOH/hexane = 1/99, 0.8 mL/min, 230 nm; tr (major) = 12.81 min, tr (minor) = 12.25 min). [α]D 25 = -4.1 (c = 1.0, CHCl3); 1H NMR (400 MHz, CDCl3): δ 7.66-7.64 (m, 2H), 7.41-7.33 (m, 3H), 6.78 (s, 1H), 6.57-6.56 (m, 1H), 1.99 (d, J = 1.3 Hz, 3H), 1.73 (s, 3H), 0.29 (s, 9H); 13C NMR (100 MHz, CDCl3): δ 138.93, 135.39, 131.69, 129.13, 128.40, 128.31, 128.15, 120.78, 118.43, 72.59, 29.35, 13.66, 1.20; IR (ATR) ν 2958.1, 1625.8, 1445.3, 1253.8, 1114.1, 991.9, 842.7, 751.0, 692.1 cm-1; MS (EI): 363 (M+, 14), 355 (M+2, 14), 284 (85), 269 (35), 194 (97), 185 (82), 115 (82), 73 (100); HRMS (EI): Exact mass calcd for C17H22 79BrNOSi: 363.0654; found: 363.0657.
notes: stereoselective, 84% ee, sealed tube used, Wittig reaction (stage 1)
